items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and it’s my pleasure to have Tom Baker as my guest here... [INTERVIEWEE] Thanks, Monk.

ctx.x: Tom was interviewed on September 13, 1997 at the Allegheny Jazz Party in Chautauqua, New York by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
We’re filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe and it’s my pleasure to have Tom Baker as my guest here in Chautauqua, New York. Welcome.
